verdicts.reason: Both use the same banner layout. Both drop 'The Quiet Hours' book cover, which was the original's hero image, and shrink the Inkwell & Lantern logo to an illegible speck in the top-left corner. Both also leave a large empty band on the card's left side and set the fine print too small to read. A's logo text looks clipped ('NKWELL & ANTERN'), which damages the brand. B's logo looks intact but is even smaller, and its body copy has an awkward 'Tea / and toast' line break. B edges ahead only because its logo appears whole.
